release_notes: Windows hotfix. The 2.6.6 Windows window tried to show its loading page before the WebView2 control had been initialised, which produced "The instance of CoreWebView2 is uninitialized" and then wrongly suggested the runtime was missing. The window now initialises first; the installer also installs Microsoft's Edge WebView2 Runtime when a PC does not have it, and if neither the runtime nor the installer can run, ByteBook opens the same books in the default browser instead of a dead window. The macOS build is 2.6.6 plus this version number; no macOS code changed.
